title: Subfield-restricted inverse phases as low-genus character sums
summary: On scalar subfield lines, relative trace turns inverse phases into rational functions with explicitly controlled simple poles.
content: On scalar subfield lines, relative trace turns inverse phases into rational functions with explicitly controlled simple poles. Combine coincident residues, retain excluded input points even when their poles cancel, and include infinity corrections. This gives useful algebraic models; the probes are not fast general point-counting implementations.
whenToUse: Rewriting inverse phases restricted to scalar subfield lines as rational character sums.
limitations: Retain excluded input points after pole cancellation and account for infinity. These probes are not fast general point-counting implementations.
